signUpIntro: Free, and ready for your first meeting in two minutes.
name: Full name
checkEmailMagic: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
checkEmailVerify: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmailReset: If an account exists for {email}, we sent it a link to choose a new password.
noMailServer: No mail server is configured on this instance: the link is written to the server log.
forgotIntro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
resetInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
twoFactorIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when turning on two-step verification.
inviteOnly: Sign-up is by invitation on this instance. Ask a workspace admin to invite you.

failure.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first: we just sent you a new link.
failure.userExists: An account already exists with this address. Sign in instead.
failure.weakPassword: Choose a password of at least 10 characters.
failure.signupNotAllowed: Sign-up is by invitation on this instance. Ask a workspace admin to invite you.
failure.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
failure.linkExpired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
failure.ssoRequired: Your organisation requires single sign-on for this address: use the sign-in button of your company.
failure.ssoNoProvider: No company sign-in is set up for this address. Use your password or a sign-in link.
failure.accountDisabled: This account has been disabled. Contact the administrator of this service if you think it is a mistake.
failure.passkeyFailed: This passkey could not sign you in: it may have been removed from your account. Sign in another way, then add it again.

magicHint: We send you a link that signs you in, no password needed.
ssoHint: Your company signs you in: enter your work address, you continue on its sign-in page.
